header.one_line: Madhya Pradesh, from the Satpura hills at Pachmarhi to the temples of Khajuraho and Orchha

rules.title: Pachmarhi view points: two-wheelers allowed, for a fee
rules.detail: A motorcycle with up to two people pays 100 rupees for the view points, or 50 rupees for a single one, on the reserve's rate list.
rules.set_by: Satpura Tiger Reserve, Madhya Pradesh Forest Department

source.title: Excursion and Charges - Satpura Tiger Reserve

rules.title: Pachmarhi: trained guide fee for touring all areas
rules.detail: The rate list adds a fee of 600 rupees for a registered trained guide when touring all the tourist areas of Pachmarhi.
rules.applies_to: Visitors touring the forest view points
rules.set_by: Satpura Tiger Reserve, Madhya Pradesh Forest Department

source.title: Excursion and Charges - Satpura Tiger Reserve

rules.title: Pachmarhi zone: open sunrise to sunset, all year
rules.detail: Private vehicles may enter the Pachmarhi zone, with no daily cap on vehicles. Visits run from sunrise to sunset and the zone stays open through the monsoon.
rules.set_by: Satpura Tiger Reserve, Madhya Pradesh Forest Department

source.title: FAQ's on visit to Satpura Tiger Reserve Hoshangabad

rules.title: Satpura safari zones: shut 16 June to 30 September
rules.detail: The Madhai and Churna zones close for the monsoon. Safaris also stop on Wednesday afternoons and on Holi and Diwali.
rules.set_by: Satpura Tiger Reserve, Madhya Pradesh Forest Department

source.title: FAQ's on visit to Satpura Tiger Reserve Hoshangabad

season.note: October to March is the comfortable window; the monsoon reaches Pachmarhi at the end of June and May is the hottest month on the plains.

hazards.title: Heavy monsoon rain on the Pachmarhi plateau
hazards.detail: The monsoon arrives at the end of June; July and August each bring more than 500 millimetres, far more than the surrounding district.

hazards.title: Summer heat around Khajuraho
hazards.detail: The average daily maximum is about 43 degrees Celsius in May and about 41 in June.
